descriptionText:
Carl Saunders - Eclecticism (LEL Music / SNL Records LLCLCS2, 2000).
UPC 611885100220.

With Billy Childs, piano; Bob Magnusson, bass; Santo Savino, drums;
Assa Drori, concertmaster. Saunders is joined by strings and
French horns.

1. Fascinating Rhythm (5:15)
2. Reaching For You (7:24)
3. Valtz Opus 64 #2 (4:48)
4. First Gift (9:10)
5. The Surrey With The Fringe On Top (5:20)
6. Last Night When We Were Young (5:22)
7. The Price of Admission (5:34)
8. Penticton (5:27)
9. Night Reverie (7:17)
10. Old Folks (7:44)
11. Blues For The Common Man (7:13)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
